title: Replication Codebase: Market-Channel Orientation, Capability Constraints, and Sustainability Decoupling: Evidence from European Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises
description:
Replication codebase, econometric models, and estimation routines for the empirical study: "Market-Channel Orientation, Capability Constraints, and Sustainability Decoupling: Evidence from European Small and Medium-Sized Enterprises", published in Business Strategy and the Environment (Wiley).

This package contains the complete set of Python scripts to clean and harmonize microdata, estimate joint Bivariate Probit models with disturbance error correlation (ρ), execute Inverse Propensity Score Weighting (IPW-CATE) models testing treatment effect heterogeneity and the 'Valley of Death', perform 1:1 Nearest-Neighbor Propensity Score Matching (PSM) with Rosenbaum sensitivity bounds, estimate Ordered Probit operating cost impacts, and run comprehensive econometric robustness checks (including survey-weighted probits and delta-method probability-scale second differences).

Data Access: Microdata is sourced from Flash Eurobarometer 498 (ZA7806, GESIS Data Archive, DOI: 10.4232/1.13941) and Eurostat Digital Intensity Index indicators (isoc_e_dii). Raw data files are publicly accessible and can be placed in Data/Raw/ as described in the README.
